title: Reward-Free Continual Adaptation for Resilient Space Robots
abstract: arXiv:2608.23452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Space robots operate in extreme environments where hardware degradation can critically compromise traditional control strategies. While continual reinforcement learning offers a promising mechanism for online adaptation, it inherently requires access to a reward signal during deployment. However, precise reward computation in space is often infeasible due to the lack of external tracking systems and the overall complexity of the environment. To address the challenge of unobservable rewards, we introduce a reward-free continual learning framework that leverages latent-state world models. By pre-training a model-based agent across diverse simulations, the world model learns a robust predictor of the reward structure within its latent space. Upon deployment to an environment with severe hardware degradation, we freeze the observation encoder and reward predictor to update only the transition dynamics of the world model through unsupervise

translated_title: 无奖励连续适应用于弹性太空机器人
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23452v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：太空机器人在极端环境中运行，硬件退化可能严重危及传统控制策略。虽然连续强化学习为在线适应提供了一种有前景的机制，但它本质上要求部署期间能够访问奖励信号。然而，由于缺乏外部跟踪系统以及环境的整体复杂性，在太空中精确计算奖励往往不可行。为了解决奖励不可观测的挑战，我们引入了一种无奖励连续学习框架，利用潜在状态世界模型。通过在多种模拟中预训练基于模型的智能体，世界模型在其潜在空间内学习奖励结构的稳健预测器。当部署到硬件严重退化的环境中时，我们冻结观测编码器和奖励预测器，仅通过无监督方式更新世界模型的转移动力学。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无奖励连续学习框架，通过冻结观测编码器和奖励预测器，仅更新世界模型的转移动力学，使太空机器人在硬件退化时无需奖励信号即可实现自适应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a reward-free continual learning framework that freezes the observation encoder and reward predictor while updating only the transition dynamics of the world model, enabling space robots to adapt under hardware degradation without reward signals.
